name: Widgets
description: Widgets on one screen: the time and the weather, your agents at a glance, the usage left on your Claude and Codex accounts and your pull requests with their checks, in the sidebar, in each chat's Session Info and on every New Tab.

scopes.agent:read: Count the agents at work in this session.
scopes.agent_chat:read: Show which chats wait for you, which work and which finished today.
scopes.usage_app:read: Read the usage left on your Claude and Codex accounts from cmux's Usage app.
scopes.integration:github:read: Read your pull requests, their checks and reviews with the connected GitHub account.
scopes.storage:local: Remember your city for the weather.
scopes.net:geocoding-api.open-meteo.com: Find your city's place on the map.
scopes.net:api.open-meteo.com: Read the weather for your city.
scopes.actions:run: Open a chat or a pull request when you click it.
